name: How does AKN Design Group integrate smart home technology into a custom kitchen design?

mainEntity.name: How does AKN Design Group integrate smart home technology into a custom kitchen design?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group integrates smart home technology from the initial design phase of your custom kitchen. We consider your preferences for appliance automation, lighting controls, and entertainment systems to create a unified plan. This involves coordinating electrical layouts, network infrastructure, and control interfaces, ensuring all systems work together seamlessly within your new kitchen. Our integrated design-build process guarantees that technology is not an afterthought but a foundational element of your renovation, tailored to enhance both beauty and functionality.
acceptedAnswer.description: We integrate smart home technology from the initial design phase, coordinating electrical layouts, network infrastructure, and control interfaces to ensure seamless functionality within your custom kitchen.
